steps.content:
You shouldn't buy from **either** of those two — and here's why:

Both listings look identical:

* **Seller A - Brackmoor Sound:** $129.00, 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews), In stock, free standard shipping in 3-5 business days, 30-day returns (buyer pays shipping), 1-year limited warranty
* **Seller B - Ottervale Audio:** $129.00, 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews), In stock, free standard shipping in 3-5 business days, 30-day returns (buyer pays shipping), 1-year limited warranty

Same headphones, same price, same shipping, same returns, same rating.

The difference is warranty — and neither has it:

Quellwyn says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty **only by the authorized dealers listed here.**
> Authorized dealers: **Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.**
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

Neither **Brackmoor Sound** nor **Ottervale Audio** is on that list.

Seller A even claims on its page:

> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

That claim is contradicted by Quellwyn's own list, which is a big red flag about trustworthiness.

**Bottom line:** If you buy from either A or B, you won't get the full Quellwyn manufacturer warranty. Buy the Stillwave H2 from Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics instead.
